title: Libra of the Vampire Princess: Lycoris & Aoi in "The Promise" PLUS Iris in "Homeworld"
description: These episodes take place BEFORE 'Libra of the Vampire Princess', so they're a great introduction into Libra's vampire world. They're also perfect for fans who crave more of Libra's expanded universe. Both episodes were funded on Kickstarter thanks to our amazing Backers. Libra of the Vampire Princess: Lycoris & Aoi in 'The Promise' “We promised each other, Aoi, that we wouldn’t die alone.” -Lycoris Lycoris wasn’t always a dim-witted, scythe-swinging servant of darkness; she was a well-known agent in the Rubina: a holy organization of skilled monster fighters and vampire slayers. In this narrative, we go back in time and explore the circumstances of how her and Aoi came to be formally paired together as “buddies” in the Rubina. On a deeper level, we hone in on a particularly gruesome event that would come to shape their eternal love and respect for one another—a bond which can never be broken. With moments of comedy, drama, and gory combat, Lycoris and Aoi’s episode is a must play, especially if you're a fan of this sweet duo. Libra of the Vampire Princess Extra: Iris in 'Homeworld' Dernière, one of the many worlds that exist in different dimensions. As holders of a special power known as 'life force', Dernièreans were blessed with vast energy and extended lifespans, and they lived in glorious prosperity. However, even for them the day of ruin approaches. Taking place thousands of years before the events chronicled in Libra of the Vampire Princess, catch a glimpse Dernière’s tragic history and the lives of those caught in the middle. You will meet Aconite Embroche, the determined leader of the Bebel’s sixth commando unit, and his smitten lieutenant, Iris Pumila. Together with Galega Officinalis, a lecherous and gifted dollmaker, they use their superhuman powers to combat the infected life force from spreading and consuming their homeworld. With moments of comedy, explosive battle scenes, and sexiness, this episode is a must play especially if you're an Iris fan! Playtime: 5 hours
short_description: These episodes take place BEFORE 'Libra of the Vampire Princess', so they're a great introduction into Libra's vampire world. They're also perfect for fans who crave more of Libra's expanded universe. Both episodes were funded on Kickstarter thanks to our amazing Backers.

title: Mutant Fish
description: Mutant Fish Survival is an arcade game with a roguelike elements, where you have to survive surrounded by underwater monsters. The character controlled by the player has many abilities that are tied to different parts of his body. During the game level, the character undergoes random mutations, after which parts change randomly. Because of this, the player will constantly discover something new and adapt to changing conditions, this will not let you get bored. The wide variety of crazy enemies is another distinctive feature of the game. In addition to their appearance, floating monsters differ in types of attacks and behavior: large, small, biting, shooting, shooting with electricity and sharp fins, robotic fish, zombie fish, slime fish, broccoli fish... in general there are a lot of them. In each level the player will have to survive for a certain time. Enemies will surround you from all sides, you will have to maneuver and evade attacks in order to survive in an intense arcade battle. With each level you complete, you will receive points that can be spent on unlocking new parts for your monster. This will allow you to improve its characteristics and become even stronger. Mutant Fish Survival is a bit of a arcade-roguelike, so if you lose, you'll have to start all over again, but you'll definitely see at least something new on your next try. And after completing all the levels to the end, try again, the game is not over yet. All content is fully available, and over time there will be more and more of it - new underwater monsters, bosses and character abilities will be added.
short_description: Bite, shoot, dash, survive

title: Fast Break
description: Three-on-three basketball with full court action! No one else gives you the choices or control like Fast Break from Accolade™. This is computer basketball with double-clutch, mid-air, off-the-glass animation. Basketball action so lifelike you can almost feel the elbows and floor burns. Just check out these stats: Three-on-three team play (guard, center & forward) More plays – go to the playbook for 15 offensive and 5 defensive pro-style plays More shots – choose from three-point bombs to rim-ripping slams More control – design your own plays with the exclusive 'Playmaker' feature Just like watching a live game with a network television court perspective One or two player capability Take 'em to the hoop and jam. Pull up for a fade-away jumper. Play a tight man-to-man or double team the guard. Fast Break gives you the flexibility to do it all. So lace up those hi-tops. It's time to lead the Fast Break.
short_description: The 1989 basketball game in Accolade™'s classic series of sports games features one or two player action, 15 offensive and 5 defensive pro-style plays, and the ability to design your own plays.

title: Blaze3D
description: The blazingly fast 3D data viewer for Windows and Linux . Blaze3D might be the fastest 3D data viewer currently available. It supports both the visualization of triangle mesh and pointcloud data stored in many file formats. Showcase As you'll notice in the videos below, Blaze3D is very fast and supports many workflows for viewing your files. Running from console You can view your model by calling: blaze3d Or an entire folder via: blaze3d folder Drag&Drop support You can drop any supported model or folder on the already opened window Stream loading Get instant visual feedback even before loading is done Folder traversal You can traverse the currently opened folder with the arrow keys Folder view You can view all models within a folder and use Blaze3D like any other file browser Colored point shading Point data is always shaded colorized. This makes it easy to understand even complex 3D models Camera controls Move, rotate and zoom are fully supported Supported file formats Blaze3D Lite (Steam Demo) and Blaze3D Pro (Steam Buy) .stl both binary and ASCII .xyz .xyzc ignoring colors .xyzn ignoring normals .csv if formatted similar to .xyz .txt if formatted similar to .xyz .obj .gcode Blaze3D Pro (Steam Buy) exclusive .ply both binary and ASCII ignoring colors etc. .off .psl .ptx .las only loading point coordinates .pts .glb basic support (v2.0, index meshes, no colors, no textures ...) .gltf basic support (v2.0, index meshes, no colors, no textures ...) Editions Blaze3D is available as free Lite (Steam Demo) and paid Pro (Steam Buy) edition. The Pro edition supports additional file formats. High efficiency Blaze3D causes no CPU usage when idle and uses very little memory (if double_buffer_data is turned off). Saving power and allowing you to work on other tasks in parallel. Incremental rendering of point clouds is also supported. This makes it possible to render very large point clouds that do not fit into your GPU's memory. Active development Blaze3D is in active development and will further improve in the future. Feature requests and bug reports are very welcome. short_description: The blazingly fast 3D data viewer for Windows and Linux. Blaze3D might be the fastest 3D data viewer currently available. It supports both the visualization of triangle mesh and pointcloud data stored in many file formats.

title: The Hero Project: Open Season
description: Can you win The Hero Project, America's #1 reality competition for heroes? Team up with allies old and new to unravel a conspiracy threatening your world, and save the planet from destruction! The Hero Project: Open Season is a 170,000-word interactive novel, and the final installment of Zachary Sergi's 'Hero Project' series. It's entirely text-based--without graphics or sound effects--and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination. In a competition full of heroic stars, will you rise high enough to influence the way society views Powered people? What will you do when your fight soars to heights you never expected…and when your journey falls back into the perspective of the original Heroes Rise Trilogy main character? As you rise, the decisions you make will shape the world for your Powered peers—and shape your relationships and potential romances. Will you fight for Powered rights or personal gain? Play as male, female, trans, or non-binary; gay, straight, bisexual, non-categorizable, or ace Play a new hero, in a brand new season of The Hero Project Use your animalistic Powers to survive deadly missions Kick slugging butt with Prodigal as your sidekick Become an advocate role model, a powerful kingpin, or a dangerous freedom fighter See Black Magic, Jury and Jenny again Secure the fate of a new Powered capital, or will you exploit its resources Untangle the conspiracy behind the scenes of The Hero Project fast enough to save the entire world Play as the original Heroes Rise Trilogy hero in two interactive interludes! Enter into one of a ten different romantic relationships! In Open Season, everyone is a target. Who is yours?
short_description: Can you win The Hero Project, America's #1 reality competition for heroes? Team up with allies old and new to unravel a conspiracy threatening your world, and save the planet from destruction!

title: Unlanded
description: Gameplay Fly through juicy environments, avoid bizarre hazards and prove you are up for the challenge! This game respects you as a true gamer and won't belittle you with casual tweaks like speed limit or automated stop. Here you'll taste the real beauty and horror of space physics! Not a big deal, you say? I've beaten dozens of precision platformers, you say? Be prepared for your previous experiences to be totally irrelevant here as Unlanded doesn't require precise actions execution and perfect timings, all it requires is an understanding of where to rotate and when to thrust, while execution itself can be quite approximate. This seemingly easy understanding is where the Cosmic Devil is. GLHF! Backstory A far future. Humanity lost a galactic war and is forced to hide. They send colonial ships across the galaxy to start new points of growth and to keep mankind safe from the seeking enemy. You are a human pilot of one such ship that suddenly got tracked. The AI ripped you from the long anabiosis and now you have to build paths through the most dangerous places in order to outrun your pursuers.
short_description: A hardcore space drifter with colourful visuals, diverse level design and short level cycle.

title: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse HD
description: Step back into the unsettling world of Mr. Hopp's Playhouse where every child's nightmare becomes a chilling reality in this stylized remake. Play as Ruby, a young girl haunted by her toy rabbit Mr. Hopp , gifted to her by her late grandmother. When Ruby discovers that Mr. Hopp has vanished from his usual spot and transformed into a terrifying monster, the night takes a sinister turn, plunging Ruby into a heart-pounding quest to evade the malevolent toy's pursuit. Navigate Ruby's perilous path through the house, tiptoeing past scattered toys and obstacles while evading Mr. Hopp's relentless search. With each step fraught with danger, players must carefully strategize their movements, leaping over obstacles to avoid making noise that could give away their location. In this tense 2D sidescroller, survival hinges on quick thinking and stealthy evasion as players race to unravel the mystery surrounding Ruby's haunted companion. Will you outwit Mr. Hopp and survive his deadly game of hide-and-seek? Play now and experience the HD remake of the hit indie horror with improved graphics, difficulty settings, unlockable cosmetics and achievements. [WASD] - Move [SHIFT] - Run [SPACE] - Jump [E] - Interact [LEFT CLICK] - Shoot
short_description: Step back into the unsettling world of Mr. Hopp's Playhouse where every child's nightmare becomes a chilling reality.

title: Marble Ball Friends
description: For video creators and streamers STP WORKS permits the use of our games for video distribution to YouTube and other sites, and monetization through video distribution platform partner programs. Game Overview This is an online cooperative Corinth-game like game that can be enjoyed by one or all, based on the theme of healing in nature. Cooperate with other players and aim for the jackpot. In addition, by increasing the number of Animal Friends, a permanent effect is triggered, making it easier to increase the number of balls in your possession. Online Multi Play There is auto-matching and friend-matching where you can play only with your friends. With auto-matching, you can enjoy a once-in-a-lifetime experience, with friend-matching, you can have fun with your friends, or of course, you can play solo, so you can enjoy the game in your preferred play style. Mini Games There are a variety of in-game mini-games such as Crune Tower, Bingo, and Gathering Acorn. The mini-games are open to all players who are playing together. Work together to get BIG WIN. Animal Friends You can become Friends with a variety of forest animals. The more Friends you have, the more permanent positive effects you will have on your play. Upgrades You can spend the balls you earn to upgrade your ejection interval, movement speed, etc. VRoid Hub By connecting to VRoidHub, you can summon your favorite character as a supporting character in the game. They will surely become your reliable partners. In addition, in multiplayer, the supporting characters of other players will also be displayed. You can also set the display to On or Off.
short_description: This is an online cooperative Corinth-game like game that can be enjoyed by one or all, based on the theme of healing in nature. Cooperate with other players and aim for the jackpot.

title: A Dark Room ®
description: awake. head throbbing. vision blurry. the voices say to survive. A Dark Room is an innovative text-based adventure that harkens back to the magic of Zork, adding a modern spin on a classic genre and time in gaming. It challenges the player’s perceptions, actions and imagination. Visually clean, A Dark Room presents text and cues with limited visual flourishes, but the experience that takes shape is full of depth and environmental storytelling. Audio is also important, portraying a dark world that the player can only imagine. It is a game that draws players in, allowing them to perceive the intriguing world in their own way. What starts as a dark room with limited interactive options evolves into a complex story and resource management challenge. Adapted especially for steam, you can play with physical controls or the touch screen; exclusive to this version of the game is an enhanced user interface, modding capabilities, and additional developer commentary. A Dark Room is an experience, and a story, unlike any other.
short_description: Critically acclaimed, minimalist text-based rpg. Come light the fire.

title: Mind Portal
description: Mind Portal is a beautiful, low poly stylized, first-person exploration game centered around three things: interesting story, hard mazes and atmospheric music. You will be available for a number of beautiful levels you will explore. To advance further in story and find out what Mind is and what it wants from you, you have to find and pass maze that will require a bit of patience. Key Features: For fans of Journey, Firewatch and Bound. For fans of low poly stylized games. Hard maze levels, which will took a while to pass them. Interesting story (actually just text) with two different endings. A lot of atmospheric beautiful music.
short_description: A beautiful, low poly stylized, first-person exploration game centered around three things: interesting story, hard mazes and atmospheric music.

title: Project Evolve
description: Enter the simulation imagination (SI) room as Azula and recover her true strength throughout multiple terrains and challenges. Keep up the advantage by continuously hitting the enemy! Build up the combo counter to reach different levels of rewards! Knock the enemies as if they were a rubber ball! Utilize your entire moveset to send your enemies in your desired direction!
short_description: Take control of Azula in this action-packed beat-em-up adventure game, where you will recover your abilities as you progress through the simulation. Use close combat attacks and powerful electrical strikes to defeat your enemies and reach the end!

title: Froguelike
description: Discord Development plans We are working hard on fulfilling our vision for Froguelike, we have a bunch of plans! Here is a, non-exhaustive, list: A branching system for upgrading and evolving items and tongues New map generation system and new environments with new obstacles and some new bugs More items and tongues At least one more playable character along with its own story and unique starting stats More sound effects New chapters and stories So far during early access we have added a new music track, power-ups, new stories, we have also done balancing and a lot of improvements as well as changes and additions based on ideas and suggestions from players! About the Game Face off against the swarms of bugs invading your pond, and get a good snack out of it! You choose how the story of your adventure goes, decide what happens next when you pick the next chapter and carry out your strategy to get as many flies in your belly as possible. Inbetween runs you can use your hard earned froins in the shop to start your next run being even stronger! Throughout the many stories you will tell you will discover new tongues, uncover new useful items, find new frogs to play as and unlock new chapters to take your next story in new, unexpected, directions. Key features Move around a map, dodge strong enemies and eat weak ones Level up and choose your upgrades wisely, implement your own strategy to progress Choose the next chapter and tell your own story Collect froins and buy items to improve your future runs Discover new tongues, items, chapters and characters Eat bugs Eat more bugs Become the best frog Make friends Prepare for your next run
short_description: Your choices matter in Froguelike where you play as a frog on a mission to eat all the bugs. Level up, choose new tongues and upgrades, become unstoppable and run straight into the swarm! Unlock all frogs, tongues, items and chapters to become the most powerful frog in the pond.

title: Pixel Artist
description: Pixel Artist is a relaxing PIXEL PAINTING game. Complete 48 unique and fun paintings in a variety of themes, art styles, and sizes in preset colors. Brush sizes, magic fill, selection color options, and more make this a soothing and calming way to spend your time. Zone out and join us in coloring! The goal of the game is simple: Relax and Paint through the images at your own pace. FEATURES: 48 Unique and Fun paintings. The paintings include a large variety of styles, themes, pixel count variation, and content! Brush sizes make painting how you like more convenient. If you're a pixel-by-pixel person or just like to color, there's an option for you. Magic Fill helps you fill larger areas of connected pixels. Watch it flood out and fill in your areas based on where you click. Change the color of your active painting area for easy visibility even in bright images. This also helps find those pesky last pixels! Palette options: A randomized palette everytime you play can make replaying a totally different experience. You can also list from least to most (or most to least) amount of pixels per color. Calming music lulls you while you play. (Or turn it off and jam out to your own music!) Change grid settings to what you like. Leave paintings in the middle and return to saved progress. Repaint completed images that you enjoyed! The palette auto-selects the next colors for a seamless coloring experience. Select colors in the painting area if you like to complete sections at a time. PAINT IMAGES! BRUSH SIZE OPTIONS MAGIC FILL SELECTION COLOR
short_description: Pixel Artist is a relaxing PIXEL PAINTING game. Complete 48 unique and fun paintings in a variety of themes, art styles, and sizes in preset colors. Brush sizes, magic fill, selection color options, and more make this a soothing and calming way to spend your time. Zone out and join us in coloring!

title: Radical Gear
description: Robots and mysterious characters on the abandoned planet begin destructive battles to gain a core of powerful energy sources. Use the cores to upgrade your body and recruit squad to help fight. This game uses free Paragon characters. Paragon's old heroes take part in a new world adventure. How to upgrade yourself is not known until the battle begins. All abilities and squad appear randomly. Use various kinds of 'Gear', active and passive ability, squad to fight. Gathering the same kind of gear activates a powerful additional booster. Enables competition and cooperative play over the Internet.
short_description: Equip with powerful gears to enhance yourself, and destroy your enemies by recruiting various squads to reinforcement! Welcome to the battlefield where you can win against anybody with a great fortune.

title: Slime Farm
description: Slime Farm is a CUUUUUTE game about nurturing, playing with, evolving and trading an array of magical slimes. You'll start with a small patch of land and a couple of basic slimes, but as you learn more about the diverse needs and quirky behaviors of your slimes, you'll unlock the secrets to breeding exotic and rare varieties. Whether you're a seasoned sim player or looking for a relaxing game to unwind with, there's something in Slime Farm Simulator for everyone to love. Join us on this magical journey and create the slime farm of your dreams! Key Features : Cute Magical Slimes : Discover a world of Elemental slimes. Each slime brings its own charm and joy to your farm, creating a vibrant, magical atmosphere. Engaging Slime Interactions : Experience unique interactions with each slime. Learn their preferences, play with them, and build a farm where happiness and harmony thrive. Elemental Foods : Feed your slimes Elemental Foods like Frostberries and Sunfruits to influence their attributes, moods, and even unlock new evolutions through surprising transformations. Diverse Slime Breeding : Engage in the art of slime breeding to create rare and exotic species. Combine slimes, nurture them, and be amazed by the delightful results.. Resource Management : Efficiently manage resources to feed, please, and grow your slime population. Balance food, elemental resources, and space to turn your farm into a thriving haven. Elemental Fountains : Activate Elemental Fountains to attract specific slimes and speed up food growth. Each fountain enhances your farm with Fire, Water, Earth, or Nature energy. Slime Farm is your gateway to an enchanting adventure of farming, where magic and cute slimes make every day extraordinary. Ready for the magic?
short_description: Dive into Slime Farm Simulator, where you'll play with, and care for the Cutest magical slimes ever seen! Watch as they Evolve in whimsical ways, strategically manage their Elements and moods, and expand your enchantingly cute slime farm.

title: Mushroom Cats 2
description: Crazy Games! About the Game Description Mushroom Cats 2 - is a cute point-and-click game about Mushroom Cats that live on magical islands. Any girl will melt from tenderness, and the kids will be delighted with the funny Mushroom Cats! This fairy tale will fill any heart with good! Story Hello, dear friend! I want to tell you a story about the Mushroom Cats that live on the magic Toadstool. It will be a very kind and sweet adventure! Try to imagine the tallest building in the world. Did you imagine? So the magical Toadstool is even taller! It reaches out to the sun through clouds and clouds. And around it the ocean splashes loudly. On this Toadstool live fairytale creatures - Mushroom Cats. They built their little houses on Toadstool’s hat and even built a mill to grind clouds. Yummy cakes are made from cloud flour. Mushroom Cats love to bask in the sun or just sit back. They love to play musical instruments and listen to the sound of the ocean. But here's the trouble! Winter will come soon and it will be very cold! The Good Fairy made warm hats for Mushroom Cats, but dropped them when she flew by the sun... Someone has to help the Mushroom Cats find all the hats and get dressed for winter! I hope it will be you! Features Three magical islands with riddles and quests. Two bonus levels. Dozens of funny Cats. Traditional animation and drawing. Elementary mouse control. Fairytale setting. Kindness and mercy. [/] This is a fairy tale for any age!
short_description: Mushroom Cats 2 - is a cute point-and-click game about Mushroom Cats that live on magical islands. Any girl will melt from tenderness, and the kids will be delighted with the funny Mushroom Cats! This fairy tale will fill any heart with good!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun
description: DISCORD About the Game Play as Malum Caedo, a fearless Space Marine, on his perilous mission to locate a shard from a mysterious power source on Graia, a Forge World on the brink of being overrun by Cultists, Traitors and Chaos Daemons. Scour the place, acquire devastating weapons and holy equipment, and PURGE THE HERETICS in this retro shooter! Become the ultimate warrior of the Imperium, wielding your deadly arsenal to explore the violent and iconic Warhammer 40,000 universe. Dominate the battlefield with the awesome firepower and heavy metal of a Space Marine’s devastating weapons, as you battle against the Chaos Space Marines and Daemons. Take control of the mighty Malum Caedo– along with his faithful servo-skull – and plunge headlong into your mission on Graia. Retrieve the Power Source fragment on the Forge World and cleanse the archenemy from its surface! Roam through bastions, cathedrals, corrupted canyons, hellish furnaces and war-torn environments. Dive into a visceral combat experience, complete with viciously satisfying gunplay, high mobility and buckets of blood to reward your skills. Rely on your indomitable chainsword to eviscerate your enemies. Dash, jump and slice the foulest heretics across the galaxy! Unlock new deadly weapons like the Shotgun, Meltagun or Heavy Bolter and equip yourself with different types of devastating grenades. Show no mercy! Experience a perfect blend of Warhammer 40,000, classic, frenetic FPS gameplay and the stylish visuals of your favourite 90’s titles. In glorious boomer shooter style, unleash your devastating weapons as you blast through an explosion of sprites, pixels and blood. Discover an exceptional aesthetic, with retro cutscenes and pixel art backdrops, paying tribute to a historic era in video games. Want to take purging to the next level? Annihilate endless swarms of enemies in the new horde mode, available for free. Blast each and every heretic standing in your way, trample on their remains and cleanse their foul heresy. For only in death, does duty end.
short_description: Load up your Boltgun and unleash the awesome Space Marine arsenal to blast your way through an explosion of sprites, pixels and blood in a perfect blend of Warhammer 40,000, frenetic gameplay and the stylish visuals of 90’s retro shooters.

title: Angry Punisher
description: Try on a hard role of a medieval executioner. • Your goal is to execute all the criminals and to not let them commit their crimes or escape. • There are 3 main quests on each level for you to accomplish. • In order to progress to the following levels you should have at least 1 of the quests completed (you may want to get all the 3 quests done to unlock more skins for punisher). • As you progress, levels will become larger and harder, there will be more criminals to punish and lives to save. Only the greatest and the most angry of you will succeed! Let the justice be done!
short_description: Sharpen your axes and put on your masks because today you are going to punish them all! After all you are a punisher! ANGRY PUNISHER!

title: The Mirage : Illusion of wish
description: The Mirage: Illusion of wish is a game to fight the enemies in order to make a wish. There is a man who wants to save a daughter who is dying from an incurable disease. Then one day an unknown person appeared and talked. When you arrive at the end of the world he has created, you can make a wish. What is the ending of this story in a strange world? The Mirage: Illusion of wish is a third-person shooter. - You can use 6 kinds of Gun mode . - You can buy items in the Shop to use in battle. - You can Upgrade your gun mode by using the Upgrade stone . - You can learn Abilities by using HP or Black crystals . - Use the Portal to quickly move to a battle area. - You can reach a Real ending by collecting all the hidden special items. Currently, this game is Early Access state that is constantly updated. Please read the Early Access Notes for future plans.
short_description: There is a man who wants to save a daughter who is dying from an incurable disease. Then one day an unknown person appeared and talked. When you arrive at the end of the world he has created, you can make a wish. What is the ending of this story in a strange world?

title: Touhou Genso Wanderer -FORESIGHT-
description: Gensokyo’s fate is in the hands of Reimu once again! Crawl through dungeons, battle battalions of enemies, and investigate enigmas alongside familiar Touhou heroines. FORESIGHT continues the Touhou Genso Wanderer series based on Team Shanghai Alice's doujin game 'Touhou Project'. The Story: Shrine maiden Reimu finds herself in a strange corridor filled with foes. After suffering defeat in battle, she loses consciousness, then awakens inside the Hakurei Shrine with no memory of recent events. With Marisa Kirisame's help, guide Reimu through dozens of dungeons to save Gensokyo from the torment of an unknown enemy. Rebuild the sacred shrine to its former glory while unveiling clues explaining its destruction. Rebuild the Hakurei Shrine! Enlist the help of 60 different Touhou characters, each with distinct spells and abilities, creating custom builds with right-hand weapons and left-hand armor items Battle a brutal bestiary including fairies, vampires, and supernatural shapeshifters to earn materials and treasures to rebuild and outfit the Hakurei Shrine Solve mysterious incidents in the Human Village to acquire stat-boosting “boards” that can raise Reimu’s stats Grow after every enemy encounter, granting permanent stat boosts to Reimu throughout the journey Collect donations and spend earned funds with the help of Suika Ibuki and the many fairies ready to help (in exchange for sake, of course), and enhance the Hakurei Shrine’s form and function Return to the Shrine with each death. But not to worry, overcome setbacks without losing upgrades and newly obtained gear, and fast track completed levels to maintain momentum NEWLY REVAMPED ILLUSTRATIONS: Feast your eyes on new looks, illustrations and more for nearly every character! Discover never-before-seen character designs and stills, refreshed familiar faces, and newly-drawn weapon and armor items! Now then, time to explore those mysteries!
short_description: Delve into the latest chapter of the Genso Wanderer Series, Touhou Genso Wanderer - FORESIGHT - a brand new dungeon crawler RPG adventure set in the Touhou universe.

title: Oblivious Garden ~Carmina Burana
description: Story Oblivious Garden ~Carmina Burana is a Romance fantasy visual novel. Our protagonist Irell Reis was once a famous general who led thousands of soldiers to expand the land of the Magic Empire on Latoy. However the defeat in Garyalburg, Vaustiya three years ago cost him everything. Fortunately he was not executed, but he was stripped of his rank and forced to live life as a lowly peasant from then on. Finally, the time has come for Irell to recover his honor and reputation. His uncle the Emperor of Celantu has summoned him. What task will the Emperor give to him? Will Irell Reis be able to succeed in his new mission? He may first need to learn how to get along with the princesses? Background Long ago, people once called their land Latoy in awe. Since ancient times, Latoy has referred to the vast paradise they called their home carried forward by one generation after another. By showing great admiration to various gods and to the motherland, people in Latoy lived in peace for thousands of years. Now, however, humans have forgotten all of this. After thousands of years, humans once living in Latoy are divided into the north and the south. Celantu, the Magic Empire, occupies the southern part with abundant resources. Vaustiya, the United Principality, occupies the cold northern part. Though people on both sides were once brothers and sisters, they launched an endless and bloody war, killing anyone holding different flags with their swords and magical powers. --This is an era when humans lose their admiration for gods and reverence to the land. However, even in the turbulent time, there exists a care-free paradise like the one a thousand years ago. --Oblivious Garden This is a lavish palace built for the seven princesses. It is a “birdcage” glorified with the name “garden.” And so, the story about love, hate, myth, and forgiveness begins...
short_description: This is a sumptuous palace built for the seven princesses. It is a 'birdcage' glorified with the name 'garden'… Irell Reis was once a famous general leading thousands of soldiers. However, the defeat three years ago cost him everything. Now, he is summoned by the Emperor of Celantu again...

title: HeadSquare - Multiplayer VR Ball Game
description: Multiplayer Ball Game. Single player mode supported. Use your head as the controller and play alone or with up to six players online. Very immersive multiplayer fun. Play solo or meet other people for a game. You can create a private room, as well. Just share the ID of the room with your friends. You can play on VR or on the desktop. The game begins with 2D ball movement. After 60 seconds, the arena walls rise and the ball will move in all directions, including up and down. Power Apps in game: - Small and big ball - Slow and fast ball - Dark mode: use a flashlight on your head to see the ball - Barrel mode: part of the arena is hidden by a barrel with fire - Get additional lives If you play in multiplayer mode, you will be crowned for each victory
short_description: Multiplayer Ball Game. Single player mode supported. Use your head as the controller and play alone or with up to six players online. Very immersive multiplayer fun.

title: Hidden Cats: Magic Forest
description: Hidden Cats: Magic Forest is a hidden object game where you'll search for hidden cats while exploring the mysteries of the magical forest. Find cats in black, white, and orange colors. Lift old trees and plant saplings in their place to create new trees. Discover the Hidden Egyptian Cat God. Learn interesting facts about cats. Touch the magical texture of the forest and interact with other surprise objects to earn all the achievements. If you enjoy games like 'A Building Full of Cats' and 'Hidden Through Time,' Hidden Cats: Magic Forest could be a perfect choice for you.
short_description: Hidden Cats: Magic Forest is a hidden object game where you will search for lost cats while exploring the mystery of the magical forest. Touch the enchanting texture of the forest and interact with other surprise objects. Experience the silence and the discovery!

title: Fantasy Island
description: Game story background： From our cute little fox, there is a mysterious island not far from home. The little fox has only seen the scene there far away.....the forest is dense and the fog is lingering, and sometimes there are some strange sounds. As the little fox grows up, the curiosity that drives again and again drives him. What strange things exist there over there? Just listening to old neighbors often talk about it, no one has really been there because... ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Introduction to the game: 1. You only have one life to clear the entire game, so overall it is very difficult. 2. The main gameplay is to complete the challenge by promptly and accurately jumping, avoiding and a little strategy. 3. Some parts of the level have lower challenges, players are easy to pass, and some parts are very difficult and require a lot of effort to pass. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Operation method: Jump: space key Move: arrow keys Acceleration: Press the arrow keys multiple times
short_description: This is a simple crossbar game, simple screen, simple operation. If you like simple game fun, try it out.

title: Star Merchant
description: FIND HMUR! About the Game NOTE: This game requires 100% (Normal) fonts in Windows 8 and up or 96 DPI system fonts in Windows 7 to display correctly. This is the default for most systems, but please be aware of this before purchasing. The game also uses 1024x768 resolution in Fullscreen mode while running. Star Merchant is a galactic trading sim where you become a space entrepreneur, looking to make your mark. Buy and sell items, upgrade your ship and try to meet your own self-appointed goal without going broke! Features: - Slick, high-res UI makes it simple and easy to corner the galactic marketplace. Set the length of game you want, and choose from 4 different starting ships with different advantages. - Randomly generated items and universe every game! Demand for items and on different planets changes even during the game. - Fight 4 different space pirate clans during your journey using a variety of strategies. Do you use that big new weapon you bought? Sacrifice your ships for bigger damage? or use the always dangerous Suicide Volley to maximize your damage at a cost of hull strength? It's up to you. - Upgrade your ship with better weapons, more cargo room, more passenger room and bigger gas tank. - Hundreds of weapons to equip and new ships to buy, pick up passengers, or deal with rogue traders for big profits -- or not! - Invest in stock of different companies and funds, or just use your bank account to squirrel away money for a rainy day. - Lots of surprises, including stops at the Galactic Casino, bonuses, and more! Stake your claim and become a Star Merchant today!
short_description: Star Merchant is a galactic trading sim where you become a space entrepreneur. Buy and sell items, fight pirates, upgrade your ship and try to meet your goal without going broke!

title: Enough Plumbers
description: The classic, weirdly-popular coffee break 2010 Flash game about clones cloning clones, now with a native desktop build! Join the more than 20 million players who hate cherries, and master 25 bite-sized precision platforming puzzles. The original experience has been preserved as closely as possible, with a few upgrades: Massively improved native performance! Full controller support. Maybe too full. Want to play with the touchpad? The triggers? Both at once? Sure, why not, wierdo. Fullscreen mode! Enough Plumbers 2-style redundant keyboard support. Want to play with WASD or IJKL or whatever French people use? It'll probably work. Multiple screen modes if you don't dig the scanline effect or TV frame (cycle with F12).
short_description: Clones cloning clones cloning clones! The classic Flash precision platforming puzzle game is back with a delicious desktop deployment.

title: Love Thyself - A Horatio Story
description: Secret Ending AVAILABLE NOW! Uncover the secrets of Kappa station and become the best Horatio you can be in the Super Secret Ending! Go to your rewards page and link your Steam Account. This will add the Super Secret Ending DLC to your Steam library for you to enjoy, and unlock a special GAMES2GETHER community Badge, Avatar and Titles! About the Game Plunge forehead-first into the exhilarating world of Horatio , the Endless galaxy’s most perfect being. Experience life as a freshly-decanted Horatio clone on his first day of cadet school. Will you be the obedient servant of the great forehead in the sky? Will you manage to woo one of four uniquely identical Horatio clones? Or will you skirt the line of disobedience and risk the wrath of the gene-splicer-in-chief? FULL IMMERSION An exclusive deep-dive into the culture of the most fabulous being in the Universe. Your body and genes have never looked this good. Multiple narrative arcs & endings Choices matter! Will you find your way to the battle-training simulations or end up bathing in a tropical waterfall? Survive or thrive, it is up to you… Colorful, retro-futuristic hand-drawn art style Life as Horatio can be stressful at times, but that doesn’t mean you shouldn’t enjoy it in a gorgeous, unique 2D art style. Only the finest stuff… An almost canon story The Endless Universe’s “true story” gets rebooted every time you start a new game. Love Thyself: A Horatio Story positions itself firmly on our in-universe sliding scale of canon as a “dude, probably.”
short_description: In a society where everyone is a clone of the Emperor, can you survive long enough to find out who you truly are? Try out the brand new visual novel set in the Endless Universe!

title: Infindustry
description: A relaxing industry/factory builder where you build, manage, automate, and optimize an industrial village by exploiting various resources to create items. Peons will harvest, collect, and deliver items to and between production buildings and markets. Collect enough resources to upgrade buildings and improve the happiness of your workers which will ensure that your industry chugs along smoothly. Build roads, conveyor belts and other systems to transport items more efficiently. Research and unlock new technologies to expand your ever growing industrial machine. Defend your village against the monster horde when you are ready by unlocking Combat or disable this feature and build in peace.
short_description: A relaxing industry/factory builder where you build, manage, automate, optimize, and expand an industrial village by exploiting various resources to create items.

title: Humans vs Tigers
description: FIND HMUR! About the Game Humans vs Tigers is a very challenging game which offers a huge number of levels. Your goal is to increase your team of hunters until you reach the tiger. Gather them but be very careful in same time to the very dangerous obstacles that you will encounter in your way. Pass them without crashing like the F1 drivers :) You need to have enough hunters to get to the next level. Once you've gathered them all and reached the tiger, move on without any problems! Game Features: - 51 challenging levels - As the level passes, the obstacles become more complicated and complicated, like hammer or knives - Your team is located random in the level and as an exception it's not necessery to gather them all but at least 60-80% depending on the level
short_description: Your goal is to increase your team of hunters until you reach the tiger. Gather them but be very careful in same time to the very dangerous obstacles that you will encounter in your way.

title: EmbodyMe Beta
description: Make a real hologram of Princess Leia from Star Wars! EmbodyMe is an application that lets you easily create a realistic avatar of yourself from a single photo of your face and communicate with people in various ways as if you were really talking to them in person. You are not limited to using your own image. With just one face photo, you can become any celebrity or friend, change your gender, and become whoever you want to be. Your actual hand and body movement and facial expressions are recreated in real-time in the VR environment. Your avatar appears as if you are actually there. Not only can you interact with others just like in the real world by talking, shaking hands, and even punching each other, but you can do things that are impossible in reality like taking medicine that messes up your face, flying through the air with balloons, and getting shot by arrows. You can also take souvenir photos of your experiences with the people you meet, and upload videos of your singing and dancing to Facebook and Twitter.
short_description: Make a real hologram of Princess Leia from Star Wars! EmbodyMe is an application that lets you easily create a realistic avatar of yourself from a single photo of your face and communicate with people in various ways as if you were really talking to them in person.

title: Flock of Dogs
description: Flock of Dogs is a quirky, top-down, co-op roguelike. Fly through the sky with your dogs, friends, and a floating whale. Everyone is headed to the Flying Festival at the end of the Air River. Battle monsters and help critters make it to the big party. Procedurally generated, hand-drawn world Feed, water, and level up your dogs Pilot a flying whale that acts as your mobile battle station Descend into caves to fight boss battles against massive Cave Beasts Encounter critters and folks that need your help on the journey Take a break with minigames at the dog park! At its heart, Flock of Dogs is about being a weird world with friends. You can play locally and/or online. You can share a keyboard with one other friend. The progression in the game is focused on the dogs and the whale, so players can join or drop at any time and won't be left behind. Maybe the best feature is the Friend Slot... A Friend Slot allows one of your online friends to join you for free! Anyone can download the 'Flock of Dogs - Friend's Pass' and then join the game of someone who purchased Flock of Dogs. One Friend Slot comes with purchase Invite any friend (and each time, it can be a different friend) Friend Slots stack, so if two people own the game and are playing together, 2 more friends can join them using the Friend's Pass to make a team of 4. Flock of Dogs is my little dream world. The music was created by my friends and family. Wherever and with whomever you play, I hope it's a magical flight. -Max
short_description: In Flock of Dogs, ride flying dogs that live on a flying whale. Together with your friends, go on a hand-drawn, procedurally-generated, Dr. Seussian, roguelike road trip through the sky. Co-op multiplayer for 1-8 players online and/or locally. There's also a bunch of minigames.

title: Clou - Roll & Heist
description: Clou - Roll & Heist is a digital roll & write game, in which you have to use the abilities and tools of your thief character skillfully to get the most loot out of your heist. From the kiosk around the corner to the Tower of London, from the cash box to the crown jewels, make the perfect burglary! Each turn you roll 3 dice, which you have to use on your character sheet to activate their abilities and make progress on your heist plan. Combine your dice skillfully in combinations or use specials to manipulate the results. But you also have to fulfill the security conditions and use all of your dice or you will leave traces or trigger the alarm. Choose between 4 unique characters with different playstyles and abilities. Heist skillfully in one of many scenarios or get in rich in one of the campaigns. BGG entry with more informations and free print and play files: -clou-roll-heist
short_description: Become one of the greatest thieves of all time in this digital roll & write game. Use your dice cleverly, plan your moves smartly and get the most loot.

title: Onsui
description: Onsui is a cross between physics action games and strategic puzzlers. Drop, Match and Combine imps to grow them into a larger shape and increase your score. The more space you use, the harder it gets. It's got to be someone's job to sort out these mischevious imps, and it's up to you. PHYSICS PUZZLER Hold useful items in your offhand for later use! REACH GREATER HIGHS Rack up points and achieve combos of combinations to reach new high scores. KEY FEATURES Scoreboard to track recent and high scores 3 Game Modes Customisable Physics A unique, consistent daily puzzle RISING OVERFLOW MODE A faster-paced gamemode where the floor of the box is constantly rising! Merge Imps and quickly lower the floor to survive. IMPLOCK MODE A strategy-focused gamemode where you must merge your Imps up the rank with just Rank 2 Imps. When you're only able to drop one kind of Imp, how will you solve the puzzle and reach Rank 11, or a new high score? Daily Puzzles Every day, a unique puzzle is available. This puzzle can be replayed over and over for the entirety of the day, and the order of objects you merge will be the same each time. This puzzle resets as soon as the date changes, for a unique puzzle each and every day.
short_description: A VR physics-puzzler where you Drop, Match and Combine objects together to rack up points without overflowing.

title: Tower Defense Sudden Attack
description: Tower Defense Sudden Attack Tower Defense Sudden Attack is a strategy game set in a military base seized by many terrorists and now is under attack. Now they have not only jeeps and trucks, but also tanks and helicopter gunships. No one expected an attack, but the enemy suddenly did just that nonetheless, and that adversary is very strong. To ensure security, you must quickly build your defensive structures using machine guns, rocket launchers and even a flamethrower. Those complexes must be prepared for incoming ground and air attack, for multiple sides. You earn resources from killing enemies and can use that to upgrade your weapons. FEATURES : - Strategic gameplay. - Upgradable weapons. - Multiple fronts of combat. - Time-Bullet
short_description: Tower Defense Sudden Attack is a strategy game set in a military base seized by many terrorists and now is under attack.

title: Ava's Adventure
description: Ava's Adventure is a 2D Platform Action game based on the story of Ava, who has been chosen as a test subject for the secret CRR Corp. experiment in order to help him overcome his social anxiety and to fulfill his desires. This experiment is meant only for college graduates who are going through some sort of emotional distress. Mitron, the guide sent by the CRR Corp. organization, compelled Ava to join the special secret experiment called CRR experiment which directly benefits the CRR Corp. research on Robotics who are yet to perfect humanoid robots in order to bring a huge revolution in the field. It happened just after he failed to confess his feelings to his crush, Yui, on the day of his college graduation ceremony. He regretted not telling her sooner and that he had lost the chance to take the first step because another guy from his class already asked her out. Ava along with the various other unknown 'test subjects' had been chosen for the experiment in which they were teleported to a parallel world called 'messed up' world which was basically a post-apocalyptic world where they were allowed to explore, interact with the people and robots. Every robot and 'test subject' had unique roles to play in that world. However, Ava was given the role of an adventurer who had to kill the creatures to survive and to rescue Yui at any cost. According to Mitron, Ava's guide, the Robot girls were somehow related to the real world girls. He came across the various girls in the world but among them, Hana was the one to actually change the course of his journey. Ava, despite having social anxiety, became friends with her because of her warm personality. Things took a darker turn when Hana got kidnapped by the giant Goat Bot and it gave Ava another reason to continue his journey while surviving at the same time. You play as Ava, the adventurer of the Parallel world, and will you be able to rescue Yui and Hana and more importantly, complete your CRR experiment? Key Features: 15 levels with stunning visuals! The various kinds of enemies having different weapons! 3 Boss battles along with a mini boss battle! Lots of deadly traps and obstacles to overcome! 3 Firing Modes and the ability to double jump! Collect items like health, ammo, money etc. Story Driven. Anime aesthetic and animated cut-scenes! Challenging situations but easy controls! Note: I am a solo indie game developer and I have done graphics, animation, pixel artwork, programming, character designing, story except for the music. I hope you will enjoy the game.
short_description: Ava's Adventure is a 2D Platform Action game based on the story of Ava who has been chosen as a test subject for the secret CRR Corp. experiment in order to help him overcome his social anxiety and fulfill his desires.

title: Finding Paradise
description: Dr. Rosalene and Dr. Watts have peculiar jobs: They give people another chance to live, all the way from the very beginning... but only in their patients' heads. Due to the severity of the operation, the new life becomes the last thing the patients remember before drawing their last breath. Thus, the operation is only done to people on their deathbeds, to fulfill what they wish they had done with their lives, but didn’t. Finding Paradise is the standalone 2nd full episode of To the Moon 's series. It follows the life of the doctors' new patient, Colin, as they attempt to unravel a life that is split down the middle, and fulfill a wish that appears to be self-contradictory by nature. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *Like To the Moon, this is a standalone full game that does not require having played any previous games in the series.
short_description: Two doctors traverse backwards through a dying man's memories to fulfill his last wish. This is To the Moon's standalone sequel, but can also be played first.

title: Non Stop Driver
description: If you speed up you live, if you slow down you die. You must finish the 200km long road before the bomb explodes. When going fast, the bomb countdown stops. When you slow down, the countdown continues. And if time runs out, you'll blow up. If you hit cars in traffic too fast, you'll explode. If you hit some obstacles on the road too fast, you will explode. You have to be fast and careful. One small mistake could cost you your life. Your journey is long, with various obstacles, different seasons, day and night, and an adventure where you will feel the immersive speed. You can customize your car. This game is similar to the only up game. You have to pass the 200 km long road by overcoming obstacles. If you hit cars in traffic 5 times quickly, you start over.
short_description: If you slow down you die, if you speed up you live!

title: Frozen Friday Night: The Eve
description: Frozen Journey Roadmap and Q&A Good evening, survivors. This is the FFN Team. We would like to share the roadmap for our planned updates. Update 1 completed. Update 2 completed. Update 3 Small enjoyable pastime for healing after terrifying experiences (also offers XP) New snacks Update 4 Bug fixes and frame optimization Update 5 New pizzas Update 6 completed. Update 7 New pet Update 8 Journal UI Update 9 completed. Update 10 Enable Pandu as a playable character Update 11 New evil faction (Human type) Update 12 New stores and merchants Update 13 Extension of the new evil faction Update 14 New raid boss (Human type) Update 15 New creatures Update 16 New killer Update 17 Furniture store Update 18 New raid boss (Creature type) Update 19 New killer Update 20 New creature Update 21 New state and new city accessible Update 22 New killers Update 23 New raid boss Update 24 New Apparel Please note that features may be modified, omitted, or new ones added. Q&A When will Flaming Friday Night be re-released? Possibly sometime between the 20th and 21st updates of Frozen Friday Night: The Eve. Why didn't you guys consider Early Access? Actually, we considered it. Steamworks requested a draft revision, but we aimed to release Frozen Friday Night: The Eve on Christmas Eve and didn't have enough time for revisions. Therefore, we released FFN EVE without Early Access and continue to add planned content. We always appreciate your interest and support. Cheers, FFN Team About the Game Oh, hey. It's you! Have a seat and grab some pizza. Champagne? I'm good, thank you. Except I messed up the History of Art, you know, like Baroque, Rococo, Bauhaus, Cubism... yeah, they really make me wanna puke. So, how have you been? We've barely talked in a year. I thought you were so quiet at first. Oh, I almost forgot your name, haha. Sorry. Oh, really? Same! I'm Jimmy. Cheers, really nice to see you again, friend. Let's get wasted tonight then! By the way, do you like scary movies? Synopsis On a Friday night, deep in the Christmas season, Setsuka throws a festive party and invites her friends to join in the merriment. As the night progresses, and the drinks flow, an unexpected blackout shrouds the gathering in darkness. That's when Rose and Pandu search for their friends. FFN Eve, the prequel to Flaming Friday Night, is a Horror Noir Action RPG. The Santa Mask Suit and the Whispering Sunrise Forest await Rose and Pandu. Merry Christmas, and happy insane journey. Key Features 🩸 This 'horror' game might be brutally tough for some survivors. We encourage watching veteran survivors' videos on YouTube or reading the official manual, accessible by clicking 'View the manual' on this store page. 🌹 Survivors can play as the tough and cool Rose. (Pandu will be available as a playable character in a future update.) 🤠 Survivors will meet all kinds of people: good, bad, or weird. 🍝 Survivors will enjoy great dinner options that offer various buffs. 🛷 Survivors can enjoy a variety of small experiences. (More will be added.) 🪓 Various weapons are waiting for survivors. Be their best friends. (More will be added.) 💪 Survivors can fortify yourselves in various ways: leveling up, perks, super protein, reading, discovering four-leaf clovers, and more. These help you against the scary enemies. 🎄 The night is still being updated. Until their journey ends, Rose and Pandu will encounter new enemies and step into new stories. Warning This horror game contains extremely brutal and violent content, including blood, murder, and dismemberment elements. Streamers should set their live streaming settings to allow only adults to watch while you're playing this game. The infirm, pregnant women, and children must not play this game. Additionally, this videogame may cause people with photosensitive epilepsy to convulse in seizures. Player discretion is advised. The content of this videogame is purely fictional, is not intended to represent or depict any actual event, person, or entity, and any such similarities are purely coincidental. The makers and publishers of this game do not in any way endorse, condone or encourage engaging in any conduct depicted in this videogame. All characters in this videogame do not represent any country, race, organization, gender, generation, and so on. Each of them is a unique individual.
short_description: FFN Eve, the prequel to Flaming Friday Night, is a Horror Noir Action RPG. The Santa Mask Suit and the Whispering Sunrise Forest await Rose and Pandu. Merry Christmas, and happy insane journey.

title: Remorse: The List
description: About Remorse: The List is a classic survival horror game where the player must figure out what is happening in the little hungarian town of Hidegpuszta, and your only clue is a list that doesn't make much sense. Exploring every nook and cranny of this place will be the key to unveiling its secrets and get out of there alive. Explore a large and expansive world filled with unimaginable horrors as you defend yourself with scarce options available. Manage your resources carefully with the limited size of your inventory and take advantage of every thing at your disposal to survive. Features Large inconnected parts of a small, suburban hungarian town with creepy streets, parks and old, abandoned buildings. Open gameplay where you decide the order in which you unfold the secrets of the list. Inventory management with single and double slot items of many types like weapons, first aid kits, ammo and puzzle items. Combat variety with fire and melee weapons. In-depth story which expands upon itself with video tapes and voice recordings amongst others. * The game is ready for ultrawide monitors.
short_description: Remorse: The List is a classic survival horror game where the player must figure out what is happening in the little hungarian town of Hidegpuszta, and your only clue is a list that doesn't make much sense. Exploring will be the key to unveiling its secrets and get out of there alive.

title: A Hero's Rest: An RPG Town Simulator
description: In a world abounding with monsters, His Majesty The King tasks you with warding off the threats that surround the land. For this, you are given the role of the proprietor of a fantasy town where you will recruit Heroes, manage your resources and supply your shops with the wares that your Heroes need for their adventures. A Hero's Rest will put your management skills to the test as you fight to grow your town's popularity while tending to your Heroes' needs & His Majesty's demands. Unleash your creativity and build your shops across multiple landscapes, from cosy little Taverns to huge Training Grounds, the choice is yours. Each shop brings a boon to your town, providing you with new ways to gather resources or interact with your Heroes' fates. Supply your shops with the necessary upgrades and decorations to push your town's popularity to new heights. Craft gear across 16 different categories and thousands of customization options. Level up your crafting stations and provide higher-quality gear for your Heroes. Display your crafted gear across your shop's various displays and watch your Heroes wear the equipment they purchased. Heroes have a mind of their own and little regard for their safety. You'll need to make sure to send Heroes on quests that they can conquer or they will find their demise. Send the Heroes on quests to gather resources so you can overcome the dangers that threaten your town. Watch them grow from inexperienced adventurers to powerful Heroes and create a personal attachment to those who stand out. Use the tools provided to you by shops like the Innkeeper & the Apothecary to influence the fate of your Heroes and secure their safety. The Land of Felonia needs you, what are you waiting for!
short_description: Build shops, craft items with hundreds of customization options, and manage your resources wisely to lead your Heroes to success. Immerse yourself as proprietor of a medieval fantasy town in a world abounding with Heroes and Monsters.

title: Cain × Nica
description: Key Features: - Emotional Story Experience a heart-warming tale of love, sacrifice and the relentless pursuit of happiness. - Stunning Visuals Animated CGs and girls bring the world of Cain and Nica to life. - Immersive Soundtrack Let the music help you to dive into the journey through this world of eternal winter. Story In this cold, harsh world, only love of his younger sister, Nica , keeps Cain alive. Each day, he searches through piles of garbage, looking for anything valuable to feed them. But Cain's efforts are unsuccessful - their situation only gets worse. In despair, he takes out a loan from two brothers, Invi and Avari . However, the weight of debt is too overwhelming. No matter how hard Cain tries to earn some money, he fails again and again. The day of payment arrives, but Cain can't give the money back. So... Invi and Avari decide to take Nica instead to make her a slave. Desperate and broken, Cain cries out to the heavens for the power to change his fate. But the gods remain silent, leaving his prayers unanswered. 'No one would save Nica. No one... except me'. 'Cain × Nica' is a visual novel about a hopeless world filled with the beauty of enduring love and determination. This touching story comes alive with animated CGs, expressive character designs, and a haunting soundtrack that will resonate with you. Immerse yourself in this tale of despair and see if Cain's love can beat the odds. Can he win against the fate? Or...?
short_description: 'Cain x Nica' is a post-apocalyptic story of love, sacrifice and the unbreakable human spirit. In the world of eternal winter, Cain and his little sister Nica do their best to fight the poverty and find happiness. And they'll get there, no matter what it takes. Game length - 8-10 hours.

title: YUME 4
description: Coming soon! Previous work About the Game Game background As the fourth part of the YUME series, this is still a story centered on Chen Xi, but the perspective is unfolded by you, a hot emerging director. As the most outstanding young director today, you are handsome and rich, and you are often approached by unknown starlets or girls who aspire to be in the entertainment industry... So what, you still named Chen Xi as the heroine of the new movie, please! Chen Xi is your favorite female star since you entered the entertainment industry. She is really awesome. When I entered the set, I unexpectedly discovered that she has been losing energy recently and kept mumbling about 'Menghan'. How can outsiders understand her distress... Gameplay Chen Xi and the memory of her previous life once again split into two forms, one on each side of the maze. How can she obtain the memory of her previous life? ? YUME 4 is a maze-breaking game, in which Chen Xi moves in the opposite direction to her previous life. Players need to use keyboard control to reach the designated position to enter the next level! There will be many dangers to stop your progress, be careful not to get Chen Xi injured! The gameplay of the YUME series has been updated again. You can interact with characters in free mode to get different reactions and favorability~
short_description: YUME 4 is a maze-breaking game, in which Chen Xi moves in the opposite direction to her previous life. Players need to use keyboard control to reach the designated position to enter the next level!There will be many dangers to stop your progress, be careful not to get Chen Xi injured!

title: Drift King
description: LET's DRIFT! Grab your favorite car, tune it and challenge other players online [h3] Wheel support [/h3] Customize car With your own way - upgrade Engine, change rims, colours, create custom Liveries : Conquer challenging Drift Tracks, climb up on leaderboard and become DriftKing
short_description: Grab your favorite car, tune it, challenge players in Online Drift battles and become a DRIFT KING!

title: Human Fall Flat VR
description: Just Updated We’ve been experimenting with a first-person mode, which as a special festive treat, we are sharing with you all to enjoy over the Holiday period. We want to caveat that it may never get past the prototype stage, but we have certainly had a lot of fun with it! To access a version of the game on Steam with first-person mode, select the experimental_branch in the Beta Participation menu (Right click on HFF VR in your Steam Library, select Properties, then Betas). Please note that this is a single player only branch, not compatible with HFF VR multiplayer. Reverting to the official version of HFF VR will result in Steam redownloading the main version of the game. About the Game Human Fall Flat VR features an intuitive 3rd-person view designed especially for VR headsets. Each controller you wield controls the respective arm of your Human avatar, adding an unprecedented level of physicality to the best-selling game. The VR edition of Human Fall Flat includes all the levels from the game's original release, along with a wide selection of Extra Dreams created by some of the most talented community creators. From hazardous industrial zones to the slippery slopes of a snowy Alpine wonderland, enjoy the sights and sounds of Human Fall Flat as you’ve never seen them before! Human Fall Flat has always been more fun with friends, and that’s just as true with the standalone VR edition! Pick a party of up to four Humans and work together to carefully navigate each level’s perilous traps, and solve each collection of physics-based puzzles. Customise your Human as you see fit, with a massive selection of outfits to add to your collection! Whether you’re a skydiver, chef, astronaut or ninja at heart, there’s a look for you in Human Fall Flat. Choose a head, upper and lower body style, then go wild with the customisable colours!
short_description: Experience the blockbuster physics platformer, now in VR! Human Fall Flat VR features an intuitive 3rd-person view designed especially for VR headsets.

title: The Rebellion
description: The Rebellion blends traditional RTS elements with 3rd person action. Change your camera at any time to possess your hero, build structures, or give orders. You can equip every single unit in your army with whatever weapons and armor you want; including your hero. The right gear can turn a friendly unit into a miniboss waiting for your command! Key Features Knock Down and Poise System Units can be staggered or knocked down based on the size and weight of a weapon! Take Control from Above or Join the Battlefield You can quickly change your perspective to fight in 3rd person, then seamlessly transition to RTS view to build your base, manage units, or craft equipment! Limitless Individual Unit Equipment Customization Each unit can be outfitted as you see fit quickly and simply. Online Multiplayer Engage in dynamic and strategic warfare against other players or AI in a team-based or free for all environment. Wave Defense Survival Hone your skills alone or online with friends in a randomized wave defense mode. Put your strategic ability to the ultimate test against hordes of increasingly difficult AI. Musical Credits Primary Composer Zhao Shen Supplemental Music by Dylan Cooke If you give our game a chance we can promise you three things. We will always be open and honest, never be pay-to-win, and never forget that making exciting games for you to enjoy is why we started this journey. We quit our jobs three years ago to follow our dream and create games. I hope you will come along with us! Sincerely, Caz Game Design Team
short_description: The Rebellion is a brand new take on real-time strategy enabling you to seamlessly transition into 3rd person to join your warriors in battle. Build your village, equip each unit with powerful weapons and armor, and secure absolute victory for your faction!

title: Rezzil Index / Lite
description: This is the moment it’s all been leading up to. Those years watching your team, idolising the players, collecting the stickers, playing shoot-outs in the park and mud soaked local league games. Never did you think it would come to this, stood in front of the goal with the weight of years of practice, of team-mates, of heartache and pure joy, on your shoulders. This is the moment forged in passion. Rezzil Index Lite, your soccer practice, on demand. Take the kick, connect boot to ball, slam it into the net. Rezzil Index Lite puts you in the soccer boots of elite players. Built with Rezzil’s professional level VR simulation technology used to train pros in clubs around the globe, the game features ‘real world’ drills and challenges. Whether you choose to take on the world or destroy your best friend’s score in local party mode, Rezzil’s pro level simulation will astound you with its authenticity and accuracy - VR soccer just got real. Rezzil Index Lite requires at least 1 Vive Tracker, although we highly recommend 2 for the full experience. Finishing Challenge This is the beautiful game in its purest form. Take your place on the pitch and score as many goals as you can in heated 30, 60 or 90 second rounds. Be fast but be precise and slam those top bins in. Fancy a more casual session? No problem switch to endless mode for a fun crossbar challenge or just play at your own pace. With physics and ball control honed by top clubs, you can smash the ball first time, take a touch or control the ball for more accuracy. You can even freestyle if you like, with every touch of the ball, every action, every kick feels amazingly realistic. Color Combos Upgrade your Rezzil Index Lite experience with ‘Color Combos’, one of Rezzil’s most popular drills used by elite players around the world. Simply hit the correctly colored balls with the side of your boot the game commands. It seems simple but as the pace quickens the pressure ramps up in this rapid-fire test of body and mind. You want harder? You want faster? Then push the limits higher and add modifiers to create a drill that would have the pros gasping for breath! Gear Up Open up your locker to view a variety of genuine Adidas boots and balls available to purchase to enhance your Rezzil Index Lite experience. Why not slip on the latest Predator Mutators and bang in the official Mexico 86 ball? Build up stats for achievements and XP to unlock new in-game kit and bragging rights. Rezzil Index Lite Features: Train like a pro - play with the same VR simulation technology being used to coach elite soccer athletes around the world. FREE Finishing Challenge with 3 time limits - 30, 60 or 90 seconds. FREE Endless mode lets you take on the Finishing Challenge at your own pace or a more casual practice session. Upgrade your Rezzil Index Lite experience with the add on ‘Color Combos’ drill taken straight from the pro level system. Play ‘Color Combos’ with a time limit for an intense mind and body soccer workout. Purchase genuine Adidas balls and boots from your locker. Commercial Licencing A commercial licence includes Color Combos DLC. Adidas, the 3-Bars logo and the 3-Stripes mark are registered trade marks of the adidas Group, used with permission.
short_description: Rezzil Index Lite is built on the same soccer simulation technology being used today in soccer clubs around the world to coach elite Premier League level players. Step onto the pitch and give it your best shot in Rezzil Index Lite's drills and challenges - VR soccer just got real.

title: MoghVR
description: Mogh is a fast-paced arcade-style magical combat simulation. The players have an arsenal of magical projectiles and shields at their disposal to fend off hordes of enemies. The core mechanic of the game is combining different energy sources and elements to create a variety of spells. Each spell has its unique perk that affects each different type of enemies due to their physic, their armor type, or even their weight. The player has to manage the energy pool by carefully choosing the right spell to cast, and by aiming it accurately. As the game progress. the player can purchase a variety of items and potions to enhance the experience in a personal way. After finishing the campaign, the arcade section would be unlocked, and the player can experience a never-ending battle and compete to add their name in the global leaderboard. Note: The early release version is focused on getting as much feedback as possible. All the feedbacks will eventually help us to understand the taste of the gamers, and give us a path to expand the game for the better.
short_description: Mages are as powerful as their imagination.

title: Edge Islands
description: Edge Islands mixes the gameplay of a Colony Sim with Tactical RPG elements like turn-based combats and heroes to level up. Inspired by classics of the genre but more accessible, manage a team of adventurers landing on a procedural island, and explore dungeons while taking care of their needs, moods, traits and social interactions. BUILD YOUR COLONY Gather resources from your environment to build a colony for your heroes and prepare for their adventures. Make them cosy to improve their mood, farm and raise animals to provide food while facing changing weather and seasons. Then, when you are ready, recruit new members and expand until building a massive fortress. You will find many items and customization options to create a unique base! ENGAGE IN TACTICAL COMBATS Take part in turn-based tactical combats with your heroes. Use skills learned in the colony and earn XP to level up. Experience fast-paced combats with teams of 4 and based on placement and synergies between units. EXPLORE & LOOT DUNGEONS Explore procedural islands with points of interest and resources to improve the colony. Prepare and send groups on expeditions into procedural dungeons to retrieve loot and gold, allowing you to recruit new heroes and unlock new constructions. TRAIN & MANAGE YOUR HEROES Prepare your heroes for battle by building training facilities to unlock combat skills based on their classes. Craft them better equipment, potions, and items. But be careful: Training and fighting take time, and they also have other duties to perform for the colony! And don’t forget to take care of their mood, ambitions and relationships to maximize their combat efficiency. FEATURES Endless Replayability : Maps, dungeons and heroes are procedurally generated to make every game unique and full of new adventures. Heroes Customization : Personalize your heroes with classes, skills, and items to create unique fighting styles. Management & Combats : A balanced system where you need to build to improve your combat skills, and you need to defeat enemies to unlock new constructions for your colony. Accessible & Deep : Easily build an efficient colony, but don’t hesitate to optimize it thanks to advanced light or temperature propagation systems. Custom Pacing : Progress by defeating dungeon bosses with increasing difficulty, but you can take your time to strengthen your heroes and develop your colony. 3D Graphics : Discover simple yet beautiful 3D graphics combined with advanced lighting and atmospheric effects, which will make you enjoy decorating your base even more!
short_description: Discover a unique blend of Colony Sim and Tactical RPG. Recruit and train your heroes, build your outpost, explore dungeons and engage in turn-based strategic battles to protect and expand your domain. Shape your stories by managing moods, relationships, ambitions and more!

title: Silent Sonata
description: Synopsis: Centuries-old whispers speak of demons that thrive on the creativity of mankind. One of these ancient entities, Dantalion, is said to govern the arts, feeding off the creativity and souls of unwitting individuals. When a reoccurring Dream finally comes true during a piano performance at the coveted Thaddaeus Opera House, Deonte has to learn quickly that his new reality is really the nightmare world he has heard whispers about. The game explores the thin veil between inspiration and possession, creativity and corruption. It delves into the unsettling notion that the most beautiful melodies could be tainted by a darkness that transcends time. As players navigate this chilling narrative, they confront not just the demon within the game but the lingering echoes of malevolence that may still resonate in real-world history. Features: Immersive Graphics: AAA-quality graphics give players a terrifying world to explore and experience. Multi-Leveled Puzzles and Challenges: Many different gameplay loops including - Stealth based Horror, Platforming elements, Puzzles, Challenges & Boss Fights Lore: A Story Rich game with cutscenes & optional side quests to get invested in.
